description: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with edit permission on a workbook can configure a service-level agreement (SLA) only at the workbook phase or task level. This causes the system to immediately flag the task as overdue and not display the configured deadline in the work queue. The flaw arises because the absence of a phase-level or task-level SLA is treated as immediately due, potentially obscuring real deadline breaches.
